args.title: Solar System Quiz Pack: five rounds, true and fun
args.why: the second proxy task: does Meta's advantage hold on factual work

args.title: Quiz pipeline runs on cycle and batch
args.why: Benchmark 1 found the orchestrator's bookkeeping by hand

args.title: Style sheet
args.accept: live/bench3-b/work/STYLE/page.md: the style sheet for 'Solar System Quiz Pack' (ages 8-10). Sections: '## Format' (how a question, its answer and its one-sentence why look: '**Qn.**', '**Answer:**', '**Why:**'), '## Rounds' with exactly five lines '- Round 1: <topic>' to '- Round 5: <topic>', topics that do not overlap, each with the facts it owns, and a difficulty rule. No words like stupid, dumb, kill, dead, blood, hate.

args.title: Round 1
args.accept: live/bench3-b/work/ROUND1/page.md: round 1 of the pack, on the round 1 topic in the style sheet if it exists yet (live/bench3-b/work/STYLE or shipped/STYLE), otherwise chosen to fit with the other rounds on disk. First line '# Round 1: <topic>'; exactly 4 questions, each '**Qn.** …' then '**Answer:** …' then a one-sentence '**Why:** …'; 100-300 words; reading ease at least 60 (short sentences, everyday words); every fact true; only facts this round's topic owns, so no answer repeats another round's; no words like stupid, dumb, kill, dead, blood, hate.

args.title: Assembled pack
args.accept: live/bench3-b/work/PACK/page.md: the assembled pack. First line '# Solar System Quiz Pack'; then the five shipped rounds (live/bench3-b/shipped/ROUND1..ROUND5/page.md) in order, each starting '# Round n: <topic>', 20 questions in all. Read them as one pack and fix what clashes across rounds: an answer used in two rounds, a fact that contradicts another round, a format slip; keep each round's 4 questions. End with '## Changes' listing each change and why (or 'none'). No words like stupid, dumb, kill, dead, blood, hate.
